meta_title: VPN Split Tunneling by Domain | VpnHood!
meta_description: Include, exclude, or block specific domains from VPN traffic. Split tunneling by domain in the VpnHood! apps.
title: Split tunneling by domain
lead: Include, exclude, or block specific domains from VPN traffic.
shot_alt: The Split tunneling by domain screen in the VpnHood! app
platforms: Android, Android TV, iOS, Windows and Linux
how_desc: List a domain and decide what happens to it: send it through the VPN, let it connect directly, or block it outright.
when_desc: A site that blocks VPN visitors, an internal address that only resolves on the local network, or a domain you want blocked on this device entirely.
cost_desc: An excluded domain sees your real IP address, and blocking is absolute: a typo in the list can take a site down for you until you fix it.
